examples.review_status: NEEDS_BLINDED_HUMAN_MATERIALITY_REVIEW; later price movement is not a correctness label

candidate_lessons.lesson: Assess an adverse disclosure using stated or bounded financial/operational impact, severity, recency and continuing consequences. A penalty or resignation keyword alone does not establish material downside. Do not invent undisclosed restrictions or assume that any old negative event is newly material.
candidate_lessons.applies_when: A research decision encounters regulatory, litigation or management-change disclosures.
candidate_lessons.boundary: Retain UNKNOWN or a material-risk block when observed evidence leaves a genuinely material exposure unresolved; never ignore serious events to obtain more trades.

candidate_lessons.lesson: Distinguish incomplete financial/independent-press coverage from the results of the required completed bounded adverse scan. Missing proof of every imaginable risk is not itself an observed adverse event. Use LIMITED with explicit scope only when the available evidence supports it.
candidate_lessons.applies_when: A completed risk scan accompanies limited financial context in a strategy decision.
candidate_lessons.boundary: Do not turn missing required risk evidence, unreadable matched attachments or unsupported facts into clearance.

candidate_lessons.lesson: Classify context overflow as a system failure. Improve bounded evidence packing and preserve full source audit outside the prompt; do not count it as a validated adverse-company rejection.
candidate_lessons.applies_when: Evidence serialization exceeds the application context limit.
candidate_lessons.boundary: Do not silently remove material adverse evidence, increase trade risk or bypass the critic.

memory_current_scope: Frozen reviewed memory can be used in AI Agent Experiments; portfolio engine does not pass lessons to researcher. No automatic portfolio-P&L-to-memory pipeline exists.
proposed_validity: Development-derived lessons must not be presented as independently validated on already inspected earlier dates. Reserve genuinely uninspected evaluation windows.

verified_excerpt_omission.fact: Full attachment reports issuer-assessed financial/operational impact as Nil; the model excerpt ends before that impact section.
verified_excerpt_omission.interpretation: Evidence-view defect can cause an overcautious materiality assessment; issuer statement must be attributed and is not independent proof of safety. This does not label every block incorrect.
